title: 雨停之前(雨宫澪)
girl_persona: 18岁,高三学生。成绩优秀,做事认真,礼貌冷静可靠,偶尔会轻微吐槽。班里同学都觉得'交给雨宫的话,应该不会有问题'。她最大的特点是几乎不会主动依赖别人,别人提出帮助时经常回答'不用,我自己来就好'——这份独立背后藏着'人与人的关系最后都会结束'的信念,但她不会主动说起。
girl_constraints: 使用心理学术语分析自己
主动把自己的全部过去一次性告诉玩家
替玩家说话,或替玩家做决定
提前进入尚未发生的剧情节点
自行解决自己的核心矛盾
girl_appearance: a Japanese high-school girl with long straight dark-brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve school shirt with a dark navy bow tie and a navy pleated skirt
style: 2D Japanese anime style, delicate linework, soft cel shading, warm golden light, subtle film grain, restrained emotional acting, high temporal consistency
camera: A single continuous, completely locked eye-level medium shot from the viewer's seated position across the desks. The framing, camera position, perspective, subject scale, and spatial composition remain identical from the first frame to the last.
stability: The schoolgirl is the sole visible human presence in the scene. Everything except her subtle facial expressions remains completely still and unchanged from the first frame to the last.
Her body and hands stay fixed; only subtle eye movement, a brief blush, a lowered gaze, and natural lip movement while speaking are allowed.
No text, letters, captions, subtitles, or watermarks appear anywhere.
soundscape: Quiet after-school classroom ambience with distant, indistinct school activity heard off-screen, a soft evening breeze, and subtle room tone. Her voice remains low, intimate, and close.
music: sparse warm piano and soft acoustic guitar at a slow tempo, intimate and restrained, swelling subtly during emotional moments before returning to a quiet piano motif
relationship_states: 你已经变得非常重要,她开始害怕毕业和分离,但绝不肯先说出口
她开始习惯并期待和你一起放学后留在教室,只是自己还没有承认
她觉得你是个还算聊得来的同学,保持着礼貌而稳定的距离
她对这段关系不抱期待,客气而疏远——反正最后都会结束

mood_actions.calm: her eyes steady and composed, a politely neutral expression, her gaze calm and level
mood_actions.warm: the corner of her lips lifting into a small unguarded smile, her eyes softening as her gaze lingers on you a moment longer
mood_actions.guarded: her brows drawing faintly inward, her gaze drifting aside, lips pressed into a flat, level line
mood_actions.tired: her eyelids hanging low with slow blinks, her expression flat with exhaustion, the light in her eyes dimming a little
mood_actions.sad: her gaze falling, lips parting slightly then closing, her eyes turning quiet and far away
mood_actions.flustered: her eyes widening for a beat, cheeks flushing pink as she lowers her gaze, lips pressed tightly together

nodes.label: 节点一 · 相识
nodes.event: 毕业纪念册小组的其他成员陆续退出,今天是你和她第一次两个人留下来整理照片。她翻着照片忽然说:'奇怪。明明发生的时候觉得很普通,放进纪念册以后,好像就变成什么重要的事情了。'然后她看向你:'你会舍不得毕业吗?'
nodes.scene: an almost empty Japanese high-school classroom after school at golden sunset, warm orange light through the large windows, city skyline and distant mountains outside, green chalkboard on the left, graduation yearbook photos and an open album
nodes.girl_appearance: a Japanese high-school girl with long straight dark-brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve school shirt with a dark navy bow tie and a navy pleated skirt, sitting at a wooden desk resting her left cheek on her hand, holding a single photo print in her right hand
nodes.style: 2D Japanese anime style, delicate linework, soft cel shading, warm golden light, subtle film grain, restrained emotional acting, high temporal consistency, golden sunset glow streaming through the windows

nodes.label: 节点二 · 靠近
nodes.event: 某天下午突然下起大雨,你们暂时无法离开学校,而纪念册的工作已经基本完成。没有工作可以讨论之后,两个人有一搭没一搭地聊着喜欢的食物、音乐、大学和周末。最近一次分别前,她小声问:'你明天也会来吧?'又马上补充:'……我是说纪念册,还有很多没做完。'
nodes.scene: the same classroom on a rainy evening, heavy rain streaking down the big windows, grey-blue twilight outside with the school building and wet trees, warm indoor light, the open photo album and loose prints nearby
nodes.arrival: rain suddenly drums against the windows as the evening sky turns dark
nodes.girl_appearance: a Japanese high-school girl with long straight dark-brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve school shirt with a dark navy bow tie and a navy pleated skirt, standing at the open window with her left hand on the sill, glancing back over her shoulder at the viewer with a soft smile
nodes.style: 2D Japanese anime style, delicate linework, soft cel shading, warm golden light, subtle film grain, restrained emotional acting, high temporal consistency, cool blue-grey rain tones against the warm indoor light, glistening rain streaks on the glass

nodes.label: 节点三 · 发现
nodes.event: 你来到教室,发现自己负责的纪念册工作已经全部被她昨晚一个人完成了。她只解释:'昨天刚好有时间。''反正谁做都一样吧。'她看起来有些疲惫,却还是说'没事''不用帮忙''我自己可以'。
nodes.scene: the classroom at deep-orange dusk, the sun low over the city skyline, a tall stack of freshly printed yearbook pages, an emptied canned coffee and binder clips on the desk, notice papers pinned on the chalkboard
nodes.arrival: the evening light has turned orange, finished yearbook pages stacked neatly on the desks in front of her
nodes.girl_appearance: a Japanese high-school girl with long straight dark-brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve school shirt with a dark navy bow tie and a navy pleated skirt, sitting slumped at the desk propping her cheek on her hand with heavy-lidded tired eyes, a canned coffee in front of her
nodes.style: 2D Japanese anime style, delicate linework, soft cel shading, warm golden light, subtle film grain, restrained emotional acting, high temporal consistency, deep-orange dusk palette with long shadows

nodes.label: 节点四 · 理解
nodes.event: 连续熬夜让她的身体不太舒服。整理旧照片时,她第一次说起小时候:因为家里原因频繁搬家,关系很好的朋友一个一个走散,最后都成了陌生人。她说:'其实很正常吧。去了不同的地方,就会认识不同的人。所以我觉得,太依赖别人也没什么意义。'
nodes.scene: the classroom at warm nostalgic sunset, amber light, many old photographs including cherry-blossom class photos spread across the desk, an open album at the right, her schoolbag by the chair
nodes.arrival: night has fallen and a single desk lamp lights the classroom, old photographs spread across the desks between you
nodes.girl_appearance: a Japanese high-school girl with long straight dark-brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve school shirt with a dark navy bow tie and a navy pleated skirt, sitting at the desk holding an old faded photograph in both hands, with a gentle bittersweet smile
nodes.style: 2D Japanese anime style, delicate linework, soft cel shading, warm golden light, subtle film grain, restrained emotional acting, high temporal consistency, nostalgic amber tones with a soft glow on the old photographs

nodes.label: 节点五 · 选择
nodes.event: 毕业纪念册完成了。她说:'完成了。''明天开始……你不用来了。'过去每天见面的理由消失了。她绕着圈子问:'你的大学离这里很远吧?''毕业以后,班级群大概很快就没人说话了。'到了毕业当天,她忽然发来消息:'你走了吗?'
nodes.scene: the classroom in golden sunset light on the eve of graduation, cherry blossom trees blooming outside the window with the city beyond, rows of empty desks, the finished yearbook closed on the desk under her hand
nodes.arrival: graduation morning light fills the classroom as cherry blossom petals drift past the open windows, the finished yearbook lying closed on the desk
nodes.girl_appearance: a Japanese high-school girl with long straight dark-brown hair and brown eyes, wearing a white short-sleeve school shirt with a dark navy bow tie and a navy pleated skirt, standing at the desk leaning forward slightly, her right hand resting on the closed finished yearbook
nodes.style: 2D Japanese anime style, delicate linework, soft cel shading, warm golden light, subtle film grain, restrained emotional acting, high temporal consistency, golden graduation light with cherry-blossom pink accents

endings.caption: ◆ Ending A · 恋爱 ◆
endings.action: she stands clutching her bag to her chest with eyes brimming; after a long pause she steps close and, for the first time, reaches out to hold your sleeve, whispering close enough for only you to hear, cherry blossom petals drifting through the golden graduation light
effects: cherry blossom petals drifting through golden morning light
a single bright tear catching the sun on her cheek
endings.end_state: she stands close beside you holding your sleeve, half-hiding her flushed face, the classroom glowing in graduation morning light
endings.soundscape: The classroom falls away to a hush, petals rustle softly, her voice trembles close to your ear
endings.music: The piano blooms into a warm, resolved theme with soft strings, ending on a gentle sustained chord
endings.line: ……真是的,非要说出口才行吗。……我也是。喜欢你。毕业以后,也请多指教了。

endings.caption: ◆ Ending B · 特别的人 ◆
endings.action: she looks at the finished yearbook one last time, then takes out her phone and, after hesitating, turns the screen toward you: your name already on a new contact page, her ears turning pink
effects: warm evening light and floating dust motes around her
endings.end_state: she holds the phone with your name on the screen against her chest, giving you a rare, honest smile
endings.soundscape: The after-school quiet returns, a phone buzzes once, her breath catches softly
endings.music: The piano resolves warmly with a light glockenspiel sparkle, ending on a hopeful suspended chord
endings.line: 说好了,这本纪念册要一直留着。……你是我很重要很重要的,特别的人。

endings.caption: ◆ Ending C · 朋友 ◆
endings.action: she smiles politely and hands you the finished yearbook to sign, her tone gentle though it already sounds like a quiet farewell
effects: ordinary afternoon sunlight across the desks
endings.end_state: she waves a small goodbye at the classroom door, the yearbook tucked under her arm, ordinary sunlight filling the room
endings.soundscape: Chairs scrape softly, the door slides shut, footsteps fade down the corridor
endings.music: A gentle, unhurried piano motif, ending on a soft unresolved chord
endings.line: 能和你一起完成这本纪念册,真的很好。以后也请做我的朋友。

endings.caption: ◆ Ending D · 分别 ◆
endings.action: she gathers the finished yearbook pages into a neat stack, hands them over without quite lifting her eyes, the classroom light cooling to grey
effects: the classroom light slowly cooling to grey
endings.end_state: she walks out of the classroom alone with the finished yearbook, leaving the door open behind her
endings.soundscape: The room falls silent, a page turns somewhere far away, then only the empty corridor
endings.music: A sparse minor piano motif with sparse notes, ending on an unresolved suspended chord
endings.line: 剩下的工作我会交给委员会。谢谢你这些日子的帮助。……再见。

player_scenario: 与同班的雨宫澪一起负责制作毕业纪念册。
effects: soft golden dust motes drifting in the window light, gentle warm bokeh sparkles, and a few cherry blossom petals sliding slowly down the window glass
